eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 Asia Pacific Workshop on Data Science and Information Theory (APDIT)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.sponsors: IEEE Information Theory Society; Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School
eventDetail.scope: 2027 Asia Pacific Workshop on Data Science and Information Theory will be held on April 16- 19, 2027 in Shenzhen, China.  The Asia Pacific Workshop on Data Science and Information Theory (APDIT) aims at providing a platform for information theorists in the Asia Pacific region to exchange frontier research ideas in information theory as well as the applications to emerging scientific fields, and promote cross-disciplinary researches between information theory and other research areas, such as signal processing, control and optimization, and machine learning.
